source.text: ምሳሌ፡ ቀዳማ፲፡ ሶበ፡ ያስተርኢ፡ ማኅበረ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ወይትኴነኑ፡ ኃጥኣን፡ በኃጢአቶሙ፡ ወእምገጸ፡ የብስ፡ ይትሀወዙ፡

translation.text: The first parable.[a] When the assembly of the righteous appears, and sinners are judged for their sins and driven away from the face of the earth,[b]

footnotes.text: The selected printed heading reads ምሳሌ፡ ቀዳማ፲፡, ending with the numeral-shaped glyph ፲ rather than an ordinary final ይ. This source record preserves that anomalous printing instead of silently normalizing it to ቀዳማይ. “First parable” renders the legible ordinal stem and the heading’s place after the announcement of three parables in37:5; whether the anomalous glyph is a printing error or reflects an antecedent cannot be established from these images.
Literally, 'from the face of the dry land.' The opening temporal construction continues into verse 2.
